items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: I always look forward to playing with her.

ctx.x: and I understand he's back in Baton Rouge.

My favorite piano player in San Francisco and she is still there and still active is Jack's sister, Norma Teagarden. I find her just a delightful player and a delightful person and her abilities just encompass everything. She can literally play everything from the classics to the rags very well and she can just, if I may be so indelicate, she can just swing her ass off. She's just a wonderful player. Just a delightful, vital force in any kind of a group. I always look forward to playing with her.
It's funny that she's never made more of a name for herself. She's not a pushy
